name: CVEL: Lunar Rover, Tranquility
description: The CVEL Lunar Rover, a six-wheeled pressurised rover, parked at the Tranquility outpost. Shift and Ctrl raise and lower the throttle, which goes below zero to reverse (X sets zero), A/D steer the front and rear wheels, B brakes. It parks itself on its brakes when the throttle is at zero.
